mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 68 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park with clear skies, though we have a moderate air quality index of 58. We are seeing a Waxing Gibbous moon, and the ISS will be visible at 10:25 PM, passing from Mount Horeb in the west toward Belleville in the south, staying low on the horizon. Expect an overnight low of 62 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is holding an I Voted sticker contest for students in grades K through 12. Designs must be original and submitted by July 22, with community voting scheduled from July 28 through August 7. Winners will have their artwork featured on stickers for the November election. Additionally, residents are reminded to check their mailboxes before winter, as the city has a specific policy for damage caused by snow plows.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, catch live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol or live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, Verona also hosts trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Louie on July 28.
In our weekly police update, officers reported that on July 13, a 36-year-old Madison man was arrested for an O-W-I after he was found with his vehicle stuck on a large rock.

Today's flavor is the fan-favorite Chocolate Volcano. The store is open until 10:30 PM, which means they are closing in less than an hour, so you have just enough time to get there. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, and the store opens early in the morning.
